cases.name: inbound-booster-ignored-member-nested-64-levels
cases.note: The payload nests 64 levels deep: the payload object, then 63 arrays in the unknown member x.

cases.name: inbound-booster-jackpot-without-final
cases.note: No combination of final, jackpot and round is checked.

cases.name: inbound-booster-header-other-members-ignored
cases.note: Every header member other than alg and crit is ignored, whatever its type; b64 without crit has no effect.

cases.name: inbound-booster-header-alg-escaped
cases.note: Names and values compare after JSON unescaping.

cases.name: inbound-booster-header-paired-surrogate-escape
cases.note: An escaped high-then-low pair is well-formed.

cases.name: inbound-booster-unknown-members-ignored
cases.note: Members whose names differ only in case are unknown, including Exp and NBF.

cases.name: inbound-booster-member-name-escapes
cases.note: Member names match after JSON unescaping.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-escaped-values
cases.note: The GID is verified over the unescaped values.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-exotic-ids
cases.note: Non-ASCII, a non-BMP character, U+2028, HTML characters, a slash, a space and a colon in the ids.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-escaped-surrogate-pair
cases.note: The bet id is sent as an escaped surrogate pair, which is well-formed.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-canonical-bytes
cases.note: The signature covers JSON.stringify bytes: / < > & U+2028, DEL and non-ASCII literal, C0 controls escaped. The token escapes the same values differently.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-empty-user-and-bet
cases.note: Only an empty gid.partner is refused; the GID is verified over the empty values.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-high-s-signature
cases.note: The fixed gid signature with s replaced by n - s: either s value verifies.

cases.name: inbound-booster-escaped-backslash-before-u
cases.note: The text \\ud800 is an escaped backslash followed by ud800, not a surrogate escape.

cases.name: inbound-booster-round-rounds-to-integer
cases.note: The text is nearer to 1 than to any other binary64 value, so the value is 1.

cases.name: inbound-booster-boost-nearest-double
cases.note: boost is the nearest binary64 value, returned unrounded.

cases.name: inbound-booster-iat-far-past
cases.note: No age check.

cases.name: inbound-booster-iat-far-future
cases.note: No future-skew check.

cases.name: inbound-booster-iat-underflow-is-zero
cases.note: The text underflows to 0, an integral value.

cases.name: inbound-booster-exp-fractional-future
cases.note: exp need only be a JSON number.

cases.name: inbound-booster-nbf-now
cases.note: nbf equal to now is not after now.

cases.name: inbound-booster-exp-inside-root-ignored
cases.note: exp and nbf are top-level claims; members of that name inside the root are unknown.

cases.name: inbound-booster-order-both-keys-unusable
cases.note: The BoostX key is checked first; both faults carry the same category.

cases.name: inbound-booster-token-leading-space
cases.note: Tokens are used exactly as received, never trimmed.

cases.name: inbound-booster-header-array
cases.note: Not an object: a format error, not a signature failure.

cases.name: inbound-booster-payload-non-ascii-signed
cases.note: Appended before signing and signed as the text's UTF-8 octets, so the signature verifies and the payload segment fails as malformed, not as a signature failure.

cases.name: inbound-booster-payload-invalid-utf8
cases.note: Outside the gid, where no signature check could catch it.

cases.name: inbound-booster-payload-lone-surrogate-in-gid
cases.note: Never verified as a GID.

cases.name: inbound-booster-payload-high-surrogate-then-escaped-backslash
cases.note: The escape after the high surrogate is \\, not \u.

cases.name: inbound-booster-payload-lone-surrogate-in-replaced-member
cases.note: The check is on the JSON text, so a replaced member counts.

cases.name: inbound-booster-payload-raw-control-character
cases.note: An unescaped TAB inside a JSON string is not JSON.

cases.name: inbound-booster-signature-trailing-newline
cases.note: Tokens are used exactly as received, never trimmed.

cases.name: inbound-booster-checkbet-token
cases.note: A CheckBet payload cannot be replayed as a Booster.

cases.name: inbound-booster-root-repeated-null-last
cases.note: A later null replaces the object.

cases.name: inbound-booster-root-repeated-not-merged
cases.note: The later object replaces the earlier one whole.

cases.name: inbound-booster-round-rounds-to-two-pow-53
cases.note: The nearest binary64 value is 2^53, outside the range.

cases.name: inbound-booster-round-underflow
cases.note: The text underflows to 0.

cases.name: inbound-booster-boost-null
cases.note: No default is substituted.

cases.name: inbound-booster-final-null
cases.note: null is not false.

cases.name: inbound-booster-jackpot-null
cases.note: null is not false.

cases.name: inbound-booster-iat-inside-root
cases.note: iat is a top-level claim.

cases.name: inbound-booster-exp-now
cases.note: exp equal to now has passed.

cases.name: inbound-booster-order-signature-before-gid
cases.note: A JWS signature failure carries invalid_signature without invalid_gid.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-checked-against-partner-keys-only
cases.note: The BoostX key verifies the JWS, never the GID.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-signature-trailing-bits
cases.note: An unused trailing bit is set.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-signature-zero
cases.note: Canonical form, but it does not verify.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-signature-trailing-newline
cases.note: The signature ends with an escaped line feed.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-signature-empty
cases.note: An empty signature passes the shape check and fails the form check.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-partner-case-changed
cases.note: No case folding before verification.

cases.name: inbound-booster-gid-signature-over-html-escaped-json
cases.note: The canonical bytes write < literally, so a signature over the escaped form does not verify.

cases.name: inbound-checkbet-other-root-members-ignored
cases.note: A CheckBet has no fields of its own.

cases.name: inbound-checkbet-iat-old
cases.note: No age check.

cases.name: inbound-checkbet-payload-invalid-utf8
cases.note: A truncated two-byte sequence.

cases.name: inbound-checkbet-booster-token
cases.note: A Booster payload cannot be replayed as a CheckBet.

cases.name: inbound-booster-extract-ignores-signature
cases.note: The signature segment is never read.

cases.name: inbound-booster-extract-ignores-header-json
cases.note: The header is never read.

cases.name: inbound-booster-extract-gid-signature-not-checked
cases.note: Extraction runs no GID signature checks.

cases.name: inbound-booster-extract-partner-verbatim
cases.note: The id is returned exactly, with no trimming or case folding.

cases.name: inbound-booster-extract-gid-repeated-last-wins
cases.note: The partner used for key lookup is the one parsing reads.

cases.name: inbound-http-set-boost-token-null
cases.note: A null token member reads as the empty token.

cases.name: inbound-http-check-bet-token-absent
cases.note: Only the exact member name checkbetJWT is read.

cases.name: inbound-http-check-bet-unknown-partner-escaped
cases.note: The id is quoted; how its characters are escaped is free.

cases.name: inbound-http-set-boost-old-iat-reaches-store
cases.note: No age check: a retried or replayed round reaches the store.
